findings.description: AC-3 matrix names only ws.onText and ws.onClose and no SPI callbacks, but AC-1/AC-4 inventory (measured by reflection on the api jar) has 16 interfaces: also WebSocketSession Binary/Json/Error listeners, ExchangeHandler, ErrorRenderer, StreamDrain, UpgradeHandler.
findings.suggested_fix: In AC-3 list all 16 interfaces (or say the CALLBACK_TYPES matrix must contain every interface of the AC-1 inventory) and state how SPI types get a Kotlin lambda test.

findings.description: Rationale re-points only HttpDocsTest methods citing OPS-HTTP-007, but DocsExamplesCompileTest.java:651-654 (wave7s13SdsAc13_OPS_HTTP_007_AC9_...) also cites it. Only the generic OPS-REL-002 AC-6 covers it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add DocsExamplesCompileTest.wave7s13SdsAc13_OPS_HTTP_007_AC9_theWithHeaderBlockIsCompiled to the re-point list of OPS-HTTP-008 (expectation unchanged).

findings.description: CON-BUILD-004, CON-BUILD-006 and OPS-BUILD-002 keep their depends_on rows to the discarded CON-BUILD-003 next to the new CON-BUILD-017 rows; build.gradle:1 comment also cites CON-BUILD-003 (precedent: FR-ENGINE-001 rows were left too).
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the three old CON-BUILD-003 rows when adding the 017 rows, or add a rationale sentence that the old rows are kept as history; re-point the build.gradle:1 comment to CON-BUILD-017.

findings.description: AC-3 and Requirement promise headers 'in received order' with duplicates kept. The Servlet API gives no cross-name order (getHeaderNames) and only per-name order (getHeaders); the promise holds only by container habit.
findings.suggested_fix: Weaken to: repeated values of one name keep their order and duplicates are kept; cross-name order is the container's (state it in servlet.md next to response header order).

findings.description: Rationale puts markers in NaruServe-api and NaruServe-kotlin test dirs only, but AC-1 also reads NaruServe-servlet/src/test/kotlin. AC-2 'adapted' reasons omit the kotlin.md block that defines the body() extension (a copy would clash with the module extension) and import lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Add servlet to the Rationale locations and add 'declares the module extension itself or imports it' to the allowed // adapted: reasons (or exclude that definition line from the line match).

findings.description: AC-1, AC-2, AC-4 (and FR-REL-004 AC-4, FR-REL-002 AC-3 on a completed scan) can only be met by a -Prelease run with network on a release machine; they cannot run in the default build, yet Verification Method is test/inspection without saying which AC is which.
findings.suggested_fix: Mark those ACs as inspection (recorded run) and keep the default-build tests (AC-3, AC-5, release-tools unit tests) as the test evidence; state that T50 SBOM/license lines stay manual-pending until recorded.

findings.description: Requirement and Decision say headers are written with addHeader as given, but the Pitfall says the core's Content-Length is passed through setHeader. Also Requirement says the adapter never adds Content-Length while AC-1 admits the container may frame with a length.
findings.suggested_fix: State one rule (e.g. addHeader for all but Content-Length/Content-Type via setHeader) and word the Content-Length promise as 'the adapter never sets one the core did not give'.

findings.description: AC-4 (no edit under spi, no changed TinyHttpd file) is a git-diff inspection, but Verification Method is only 'test'.
findings.suggested_fix: Set Verification Method to 'test, inspection' or rely on the IR-HTTP-007 AC-4 signature test and BuildLayoutTest TinyHttpd-clean test only.

findings.description: Rationale says 'Covers ... D-364 to D-374 and D-412 (not authored)', which reads as coverage while the user decision says these items must not be covered.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to 'D-364 to D-374 and D-412 are out of scope and not covered'.

findings.description: Matrix uses five literals (adds 'pending') while OPS-REL-003 uses four; the Java 8 row says 'pending' where the results document would say 'manual-pending'. The mapping is stated only in OPS-REL-003 AC-2.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the same pending = manual-pending mapping sentence to OPS-REL-004 AC-1, or use manual-pending for the Java 8 row.

findings.description: Measured claim 'allowedHosts ... nowhere in NaruServe-api/src/main outside ServerOptions itself' is imprecise: DefaultServerOptions and ServerSettings also hold it (as data, no enforcement).
findings.suggested_fix: Reword: 'enforced only by TinyHttpdAdapter; the api module only stores it (ServerOptions, DefaultServerOptions, ServerSettings)'.

findings.description: AC-1 says 'interface declared in' the three packages; the 12 listener interfaces are nested types (WebSocketSession.*, SseClient.CloseListener). FR-KT-002 says 'including nested types', FR-KT-003 does not.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'including nested interfaces' to FR-KT-003 AC-1.

findings.description: Requirement text lacks the reverse rule that AC-2 enforces (a non-nullable table row must not be @Nullable), so statement and AC are not in sync.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'or when a method of a non-nullable row carries @Nullable' to the Requirement sentence.

findings.description: AC-1 says the nine coordinates equal the rows of docs/api/README.md module table, but those rows carry no version; the README needs ':0.1.0-SNAPSHOT' appended.

AC-5 lists suspend handlers as a post-v1 item, but docs/api/express-migration.md bullet 'Kotlin coroutine 지원은 별도 모듈로 검토 중입니다' stays a promise; PERF-APP-001 AC-4 (verified) still says 'manual follow-up'.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite that express-migration.md bullet as post-v1 with its reason in AC-3; keep the PERF-APP-001 wording note already in the Rationale.
